title: service-settings: the settings REST family (`registerSettingsRoutes`) answers an anonymous caller from its own authorization logic instead of the 401 floor; ADR-0056 D2 and ADR-0138 D2 require 401 — the fourth door blocking ADR-0138 criterion 2
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing and a measured reach**, `reach:` an anonymous HTTP request, measured on a booted reference deployment by the anonymous-sweep conformance suite of PR #23137 (`os-dev-report` `6137316611` on #22146, at `bf3ba9957`). Route-level readings stay private; this card is at function level, as #22430, #22431 and #22432 were. Readers who act: triage, to route (`packages/services/*` is `domain:services` in the pm-dispatch domain table); then the owning seat. **Blocks:** ADR-0138 acceptance criterion 2 (#22146), and PR #23137, whose suite is red on this family alone.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, from the #22146 dev report (out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's.

## What happens

`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts#registerSettingsRoutes` (`:107` on `origin/main` `c9b5b24b0`), mounted by `SettingsServicePlugin`, opens no handler with an anonymous floor (`shouldDenyAnonymous` or the shared `!userId && !isSystem → 401` decision). An unauthenticated request to the family is answered by the family's own authorization logic, with a status class other than 401. On the measured boot no settings value was served.

## Governing text

- ADR-0056 D2 (Accepted): the platform denies anonymous callers by default, one shared `!userId && !isSystem → 401` decision.
- ADR-0138 D2: everything outside the six door classes and the outside-by-construction families "answers 401 (UNAUTHENTICATED)". Ruling `6074960686` on #22146 closed the three doors the 2026-10-09 sweep found before acceptance; this is a fourth of the same shape.

## Acceptance

- An anonymous request to every route of the settings REST family answers 401 with the error envelope, before any settings logic runs; a signed-in caller is served as today. A reject-path test asserts `code` and `status`.
- PR #23137's anonymous sweep then answers its everything-else case green on a booted showcase (the suite runs in the `isolated` dogfood project).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `settings service REST routes anonymous caller 401 registerSettingsRoutes shouldDenyAnonymous` → 5 hits: #22430 and #22432 (closed, the OpenAPI and `/i18n` doors), #10349, #7911 and #7981 (closed, other surfaces). None is the settings family. Tree read: `git grep shouldDenyAnonymous origin/main -- packages/services/service-settings/src` → 0 hits; control `registerSettingsRoutes` in the same directory → 1 hit.

Dedupe words: settings anonymous floor; registerSettingsRoutes shouldDenyAnonymous; ADR-0138 everything-else settings; anonymous settings index.
